sast_rules.title: Dynamic Code Evaluation
sast_rules.remediation: Replace dynamic eval/exec with ast.literal_eval, explicit dispatch tables, or validated parsers.

sast_rules.title: Subprocess Shell Injection Surface
sast_rules.remediation: Pass an explicit argument list with shell=False and validate inputs before execution.

sast_rules.title: Unsafe Deserialization
sast_rules.remediation: Use JSON or yaml.safe_load with strict schema validation.

sast_rules.title: Potential SQL String Interpolation
sast_rules.remediation: Use parameterized queries (? or :named placeholders) rather than string concatenation.

sast_rules.title: Weak Cryptographic Hash Function
sast_rules.remediation: Use SHA-256/SHA-512 for integrity and Argon2/scrypt/PBKDF2 for password hashing.

sast_rules.title: DOM XSS innerHTML Sink
sast_rules.remediation: Use textContent or sanitize untrusted HTML with an allowlist sanitizer.

sast_rules.title: Solidity tx.origin Authorization or Reentrancy Call
sast_rules.remediation: Use msg.sender for authorization and apply Checks-Effects-Interactions or ReentrancyGuard.
